summary_1line: Dialogue on acts versus knowledge and renunciation, followed by a tale where a Brahmana seeking wealth is guided instead toward virtue and ascetic realization.

image_candidates.scene_text: The poor Brahmana in the forest offers flowers and incense to the towering cloud-spirit Kundadhara appearing before him.
In a dreamlike vision, the Brahmana sees the radiant Manibhadra among the gods distributing kingdoms and riches to humans.
Using his newly gained spiritual sight, the ascetic Brahmana gazes across worlds and beholds countless fallen kings suffering in hell.
